item.title: Editorial: Council must act on rentals
item.description: A South Toledo neighborhood is bothered by gunshots and people outside yelling at 4 a.m. in front of a short-term rental. District Councilman Adam Martinez said, “This has been a nuisance Airbnb for quite some time, but this is the first time it has escalated to this level. There were a lot of complaints and concerns over this past summer that I was not aware of.”

item.title: Guest Editorial: America is not ready for a long war in Iran
item.description: It is now clear that the joint United States-Israeli war on Iran will not result in a quick capitulation by the Islamic Republic or an uprising by the Iranian people, as was clearly hoped for by the Trump Administration.

item.title: Guentzel, Goncalves each score twice in the Lightning's 4-1 win over the Red Wings
item.description: TAMPA, Fla. — Jake Guentzel and Gage Goncalves each scored twice, Andrei Vasilevskiy made 23 saves and the Tampa Bay Lightning beat the Detroit Red Wings 4-1 on Thursday night.

item.title: Man who rammed his vehicle into Michigan synagogue was naturalized citizen born in Lebanon, DHS says
item.description: WEST BLOOMFIELD, Mich. — The armed man who rammed his vehicle into one of the nation’s largest Reform synagogues has been identified as 41-year-old Ayman Mohamad Ghazali, a naturalized citizen born in Lebanon, according to federal officials.

item.title: Pistons beat 76ers 131-109 for 2nd straight victory after 4-game skid
item.description: DETROIT — Duncan Robinson scored 19 points and the Eastern Conference-leading Detroit Pistons beat the Philadelphia 76ers 131-109 on Thursday night for their second straight victory after a season-worst four-game losing streak.

item.title: Van Wyhe helps Walleye earn road victory over Savannah
item.description: SAVANNAH, Ga. — The recently acquired Garrett Van Wyhe scored two goals, one in the first period and another in the third, to help the Toledo Walleye win 5-3 on the road against the Savannah Ghost Pirates on Thursday.

item.title: Bedford girls basketball loses in Michigan regional final
item.description: DETROIT — The postseason run for the Bedford girls basketball team came to an end Thursday in the Michigan High School Athletic Association Division 1, Regional 5 championship game.
